exposure: Fasting blood glucose (FBG) value of OGTT
cohort: The study included 365 single pregnant women who had a normal 75g Oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) screening.
finding: 15.89% of single pregnant women with normal OGTT had HbA1c ≥ 6.0% before full-term delivery, which was associated with an increased incidence of neonatal asphyxia and amniotic fluid fecal staining.
